newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex gains NLG 18 mln on property stake.
newsitem.headline: Vendex gains NLG 18 mln on property stake.

text.p: Retailer Vendex International NV said on Thursday it had sold its 9.6 percent stake in property fund Rodamco Retail Nederland NV to Rodamco Europe BV for about 76 million guilders.
"The sale of the interest gives Vendex a net profit of about 18 million guilders, which will be included in the results for the first half of the financial year 1997/98," Vendex said.
Rodamco Retail Nederland was set up in 1993 when Vendex sold parts of its property to Rodamco, the real estate arm of the Robeco Group of investment funds.
This gave Vendex a 20 percent stake in Rodamco Retail Nederland, which was cut to just under 10 percent when the property fund was floated on the Amsterdam Bourse in 1994.
Vendex said it had now sold the remaining shares as the interest was not seen as a core activity.
In a separate statement, Rodamco said it had sold on part of the 9.6 percent stake to a number of unidentified institutional investors.
After this deal, Rodamco Europe retains a 56.4 percent stake in Rodamco Retail Nederland.
To increase Rodamco Retail Nederland's market liquidity on the Amsterdam Bourse, this will be cut at a later date.
"The pace at which this will happen partly depends on Rodamco Retail Nederland's share performance and on other investment opportunities in Europe," Rodamco said.

Rodamco Retail Nederland invests in Dutch commercial property. It now owns the real estate of 178 shops, seven small department stores and has interests in four shopping centres. The fund's investment portfolio has total value of more than 765 million guilders.
